sourceFindings: Final constructor lacks outer user None activation; has_perm only carries owner conditions.
Initial five steps omit authorization and file selection.
Final gaps retain stale statements that authorization and version selection are not modeled.
A selected file null guard is an abstract availability approximation, not proof of real storage behavior.
disagreements: Reviewer proposed aliases for internal bindings. Main instead inspected exact result fields866-915 and mapped only existing outputs.

Reviewer called has_perm user argument erroneous because Python bound method lacks it. Rejected: the established finite external-fact contract includes checker user identity, resource and permission; this is not a positional Python call transcription.

Reviewer said self-equality cannot encode normal completion. Under the existing finite contract, external binding availability records supplied normal completion independently of its value; this is not a deployment guarantee.

Reviewer called version_param is-not-null inconsistent with source version_requested is-not-None. These are the intended same presence distinction in finite inputs; missing JSON key is evaluated separately.
Sorting helper is allowlisted and source versioning.py28 explicitly uses DESC NULLS LAST then -id; no need to treat it as inaccessible.
